description: Defines the DatasetListPage class for automating interactions with the dataset list page in a web application, including navigation, dataset row retrieval, and actions like delete, edit, export, duplicate, bulk operations, and UI element access.

classes.name: DatasetListPage
classes.description: Page object model for the dataset list page, providing methods to interact with datasets and perform actions.

methods.name: goto
methods.description: Navigates to the dataset list page URL.

methods.name: waitForTableLoad
methods.description: Waits for the dataset table to become visible, indicating the page has loaded.

methods.name: getDatasetRow
methods.description: Returns a Locator for a dataset row by name.

methods.name: clickDatasetName
methods.description: Clicks on a dataset name link to navigate to its explore page.

methods.name: clickDeleteAction
methods.description: Clicks the delete button for a specified dataset.

methods.name: clickEditAction
methods.description: Clicks the edit button for a specified dataset.

methods.name: clickExportAction
methods.description: Clicks the export button for a specified dataset.

methods.name: clickDuplicateAction
methods.description: Clicks the duplicate button for a specified dataset.

methods.name: selectDatasetCheckbox
methods.description: Selects a dataset checkbox in bulk mode.

methods.name: clickBulkAction
methods.description: Performs a bulk action like export or delete.

methods.name: getAddDatasetButton
methods.description: Retrieves the button element for adding a new dataset.

methods.name: clickAddDataset
methods.description: Clicks the button to navigate to the create dataset page.
